label: RBv1
reply:
**Status: Settlement prepared for human approval.** The claims system shows the settlement as `pending_approval`. Nothing is paid until a Veridia claims handler approves it. An assessor visit is booked for 18 October 2026.

**Facts recorded**
- Policy VER-1002, holder Lucas Bernard, who was driving. Vehicle: Renault Clio (2023), market value €16,500. Licensed since 2 September 2024.
- Incident on 14 October 2026 on the ring road. Reported 15 October 2026, one day later.
- He changed lanes, misjudged the distance and struck a vehicle beside him. He accepts full responsibility.
- The other driver, Ms. Laurent, is named. A joint signed accident report was provided. No contact or policy details for her were given.
- Repair quote for his own car: €2,400.
- Documents received: damage photos, repair quote, signed accident report. None are missing.

**Reasoning**
- **Coverage:** The damage is to his insured car, so this is collision cover (C2), not third-party liability (C1). C2 is on the Policy Schedule, so no referral is needed for coverage. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1" name="Veridia contract"/>
- **Reporting deadline:** Reported within the allowed period, so no late-claim referral. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="3" name="Veridia contract"/>
- **Exclusions:** None found in the story. The system also returned no possible exclusion for an admitted at-fault lane change.
- **Deductible:** The standard C2 deductible is €300. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1" name="Veridia contract"/> A young-driver surcharge of €400 applies because he had held his licence for under 3 years on the incident date. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="Veridia contract"/> The not-at-fault waiver does not apply, because he admits fault. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="Veridia contract"/>
- **Assessor:** Required, because the repair cost is above €1,500. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="Veridia contract"/>
- **Payout:** Repair cost, capped at market value, minus the deductible. The cap does not bite here. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="Veridia contract"/>

**Amounts**
- Deductible: €700 (€300 standard + €400 young-driver surcharge)
- Payout: €1,700 (€2,400 − €700)
- Assessor required: Yes, booked for 18 October 2026

**Notes for the handler**
- The first attempt to stage the settlement failed because the assessor had not yet been booked. After booking the assessor, the second attempt succeeded.
- The system's action log could not be read from the claims subagent, so I can only confirm the actions it reported.

**Draft message to the customer**

> Dear Mr. Bernard,
>
> Thank you for reporting your collision of 14 October 2026 and for sending the photos, repair quote and signed accident report. We have recorded your claim under your collision cover. An independent assessor is scheduled to visit on 18 October 2026 to inspect your vehicle. Once the assessment is complete, our claims team will review your claim and confirm the outcome to you.
>
> Kind regards,
> Veridia Claims Team
